recent.topic: Rejected advances and accepted choices use separate evidence streams
recent.problem: A409 is a player attempt but never an accepted decision.
recent.solution: Compare27-action baseline against29-action end save and join usage request IDs.
recent.lesson: Two accepted actions match exact indexed decisions; two409s match browser usage only, with unchanged APIstate at each rejection.

recent.solution: Name Dashboard, Needs you and Team moment in both advance controls.
recent.lesson: Recovery copy must use current rendered section names; existing Dashboard navigation and inline choices recovered W6 to W7.
